name: lot_developer_update_lot_elements_kind
description: Test 27 (§6.4, §16), the corrected terrain-change kind. Slot 37 UpdateLotElements takes the BDS's WHOLE 32-bit terrain-change kind, not a bool; its only use is the full 32-bit compare kind != 5 (building-development.md 4.11). A lot in state 3 without a foundation (flags & 3 = 0), with a configuration whose maximum slope before foundation (0.0) is below the lot slope (4.0 from a peak at vertex (1,0)): kind 5 -> the foundation branch is skipped entirely, so no AddLotFoundation and UpdateLotBaseTextureOccupant gets had_foundation false; kind 0x105 -> one AddLotFoundation and had_foundation true; kind 0x100 (low byte 0, so kind & 0xFF != 0 would wrongly be false) -> also one AddLotFoundation, proving the compare is on the whole value and not the low byte. UpdateLotElements always returns true. A lot in state below 2 does nothing. A lot WITH a foundation updates the foundation and retaining walls instead.

steps.note: vertex index 1 = (x=1, z=0): the lot slope is 4.0
maximum slope before foundation 0.0 is below the lot slope 4.0
kind 5: the foundation re-check is skipped
no AddLotFoundation; UpdateLotBaseTextureOccupant gets had_foundation false; UpdateSlope runs
kind 0x105 != 5: one AddLotFoundation (R8 over the one foundation ID); the slope 4.0 > 0.25 also runs UpdateLotObjectAlitudes; had_foundation true
kind 0x100 (low byte 0) != 5 as a whole value: still one AddLotFoundation. This is the case a kind & 0xFF != 0 reduction would get wrong.
state below 2: nothing happens at all
a lot WITH a foundation (flags & 3 != 0): UpdateLotFoundation and UpdateLotRetainingWalls instead, no slope work
